svg.title: The correlated map resolves the observed route
svg.desc: Arrange the correlated map by observed boundary transitions, including the production node. The coherent route is a finding from records, not newly acquired access by the detector. Visual distinction: A solid tiled network wall with disconnected cable ends. Indicates unavailable reach, not a decision awaiting human approval.
